# playwright-e2e-test

> Multi-tenant Playwright + TypeScript test framework: UI (page objects, components, self-healing locators), API, PostgreSQL, Salesforce SOQL, multi-source test data, file validation, device matrix.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules for AI assistants
- [Repository map](ai/context/repo-map.md): one line per file
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Locator standard](docs/LOCATOR-STANDARD.md)

## Playbooks
- [add-page-object](ai/playbooks/add-page-object.md): Add a page object (or component) with its locator file
- [write-ui-test](ai/playbooks/write-ui-test.md): Write a UI end-to-end test (API arrange, UI act, DB/SOQL assert)
- [write-api-test](ai/playbooks/write-api-test.md): Write an API test with schema validation and database cross-check
- [fix-failing-test](ai/playbooks/fix-failing-test.md): Diagnose and fix a failing, flaky or self-healed test by root cause
- [add-environment-or-tenant](ai/playbooks/add-environment-or-tenant.md): Add an environment or tenant (config, secrets, health check)
- [review-change](ai/playbooks/review-change.md): Review a change against the project rules before merging

## Reference implementations
- [Master showcase test](tests/showcase/master-showcase.spec.ts)
- [Locator file](src/ui/pages/demo/login.locators.ts) and [page object](src/ui/pages/demo/login.page.ts)
- [API test](tests/api/patients.api.spec.ts)
